$comment: Kontrolný výkaz DPH (§ 78a zákona o DPH): XML layout and filling rules by validity date, following the official XSD kv_dph_2025.xsd of Finančná správa (form KVDPHv25, targetNamespace below). The layout of 2025 is the one of the previous version with the new rates (MF/018205/2024-731). D1 and D2 have one pair of columns for the standard rate (Z, D) and one for the reduced rates (ZZn, DZn): both reduced rates (19 % and 5 %) are summed into ZZn and DZn, as the poučenie did for 10 % and 5 % ('v členení podľa sadzieb dane'). That summing must be confirmed by an accountant; verified stays false until then.
